resources.string: Allows KiOSk to hold the screen in kiosk mode and hide the system bars.
Disabling this returns the system status and navigation bars to the dashboard.
System launcher opened; use the KiOSk icon or notification to return
Automatic brightness needs the "Modify system settings" permission. Grant it to KiOSk, then set the switch again.
KiOSk is not the device owner, so kiosk lock-down is inactive. The dashboard works, but the screen cannot be fully locked until KiOSk is provisioned as device owner.
Set KiOSk as the default launcher
Open Settings and set KiOSk as the Home app.
